# t19.1 — Fix Header/Footer JSP Includes Rendering Empty

## Summary
One-line fix in `SecurityConfig.java` — added `DispatcherType.INCLUDE` to the dispatcher type matchers permit list.

## Root Cause
Spring Security 6.x applies its filter chain to ALL servlet dispatcher types by default. The security config permitted `FORWARD` and `ERROR` dispatchers but **not** `INCLUDE`. Since `<jsp:include>` uses the `INCLUDE` dispatch type, Spring Security intercepted the internal include requests to `/WEB-INF/jsp/common/header.jsp` and `/WEB-INF/jsp/common/footer.jsp`, and blocked them silently (the paths didn't match any public URL pattern).

## Fix Applied
**File:** `monolith-new/src/main/java/com/skishop/config/SecurityConfig.java`

**Change:** Line 30 — added `DispatcherType.INCLUDE`:
```java
// Before:
.dispatcherTypeMatchers(DispatcherType.FORWARD, DispatcherType.ERROR).permitAll()
// After:
.dispatcherTypeMatchers(DispatcherType.FORWARD, DispatcherType.INCLUDE, DispatcherType.ERROR).permitAll()
```

## Verification
- Header nav bar renders with: logo, ホーム, 商品, クーポン, ログイン, 会員登録, search input, cart button
- Footer renders with: "SkiShop Online Store © 2026"
- Verified on `/home`, `/products`, `/login` — all render header + footer
- API test suite: 65/65 PASS (no regressions)
